plurals.name: tailnet_disconnect_body
plurals.item: %2$s is connected through it and disconnects too. It stays off until you connect it, or a host on it.
%2$s are connected through it and disconnect too. It stays off until you connect it, or a host on it.

resources.string: Up whenever RexPocket is open, so a host on it connects at once.
Only when a host needs it
Starts when a host on it connects, and stops a while after the last one goes. Saves battery; the first connect waits for the tailnet.
How long it stays up with no host on it, open or in the background.
Stays connected in the background if it was connected when you left.
Stays up while a host on it stays connected in the background, and stops once none does (after the time above).
Stays up while background mode is on, even with no host connected, so hosts connect at once when you open RexPocket. Uses more battery.
Stops a minute after you leave RexPocket, and its hosts with it; starts again when you come back.
Background mode is off, so everything stops when RexPocket closes.
While you are away, says when it needs a sign-in or stops working.
No host connected · it stays up for a quick connect
Hosts on it cannot be reached until you sign in. Tap to open RexPocket.
Hosts on it cannot be reached. Tap to open RexPocket and try again.
Connect and disconnect from Quick Settings. Long-press the tile to come back here.
Edit Quick Settings and drag the RexPocket %1$d tile in.
All three tiles are in use. Choose another item on one of them to free it.
Another sign-in or tailnet. One account runs at a time; switching reconnects the hosts through it.
%1$s starts again on the new account and asks you to sign in.
%1$s starts again on the new account; join it with its key in Tailnet settings.
The tailnet starts again on this account.

plurals.name: tailnet_account_switch_hosts
plurals.item: The tailnet starts again on this account. %2$s disconnects, and comes back on it unless it is on another account.
The tailnet starts again on this account. %2$s disconnect, and come back on it unless they are on another account.

resources.string: Its sign-in on this phone is deleted.
